checklist.text: Follow a bird at Perch zoom: it preens now and then and turns its head back
A scratch reads as a scratch (short-legged birds may show mostly the head tilt)

description: Two new idle acts for standing birds in `BirbAnimator.cs`: preen (head turned back into the left shoulder, nibbling, wing held out a little) and scratch (left foot up, head tipped over to meet it, quick scratching, eyes half shut). Picked by shares: preen 35%, fluff 25%, stretch 20%, scratch 20%; gaps unchanged (8-20 s). Compiled and run in Claude's workspace; at screenshot distance the poses were too small to judge, so the look is unconfirmed.
title: 5.11 Preen and scratch idles
